# One component per collection (1.13, as on iCloud): a calendar holds
# VEVENT only, a reminder list VTODO only. A VTODO in a calendar and a
# VEVENT in a list are 403 supported-calendar-component; MKCALENDAR with
# VTODO alone makes a list, with both (or VJOURNAL) nothing.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: todo.ics
< status 403
< error cal:supported-calendar-component

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 404

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 403
< error cal:supported-calendar-component

> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen/
> Auth: alex
>

< status 403

> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <B:mkcalendar xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:set><A:prop><B:supported-calendar-component-set><B:comp name="VJOURNAL"/></B:supported-calendar-component-set></A:prop></A:set></B:mkcalendar>
< status 403
< error cal:supported-calendar-component

# Without a component set it is a calendar of events (a calendar named
# "erinnerungen" of 1.11/1.12 stays one).
> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen/
> Auth: alex
< status 201

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:prop><B:supported-calendar-component-set/><A:displayname/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen/ cal:supported-calendar-component-set VEVENT
< value-lacks /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen/ cal:supported-calendar-component-set VTODO
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen/ d:displayname erinnerungen

# An id is a calendar or a list: a list cannot take the calendar's id,
# nor a calendar the list's.
> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <B:mkcalendar xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:set><A:prop><B:supported-calendar-component-set><B:comp name="VTODO"/></B:supported-calendar-component-set></A:prop></A:set></B:mkcalendar>
< status 405

> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/
> Auth: alex
< status 405
